WHAT THE BOARD WON:
the pill PERSISTS. It cleared itself after 4s, on the reasoning that a
second starter should read as its own event. 306:2186 draws it as a standing

the pill is the family's Badge (333:2358), not a fourth hand-rolled span:

`--bk-success-text` (#057A55) where the board names `green/700` (#046C4E).
radius unit     `rounded-full` -> `rounded-[9999px]`. Tailwind v4 compiles
`rounded-full` to `calc(infinity * 1px)`, which the browser
reports as `3.35544e+07px` — a value no length parser reads,
so the radius came back UNCOMPARABLE rather than equal. Same
pixel, a number the diff can see. All four Badge instances
state `rounded-[9999px]` on the board anyway.
Plus everything in surfaces/brand-starters.json — same screen, same cards.
NOT JOINED — TWO BOARDS DISAGREE, and the panel's own arithmetic settles it:
306:2194 / 306:2201 / 306:2208, the LEFT column of cards, carry
`width: 136px` here while 152:148 and its five siblings carry `width: 116px`
for the same six cards one board over. 116 is the one that can be true:
the gallery is 280 wide on 16px gutters with a 16px column gap, so a card is
(280 - 32 - 16) / 2 = 116, and two 136s plus the gap and the gutters is 320
in a 280 panel. 136 is the thumb frame's width leaking onto the card frame —
152:149 carries exactly that number on the board where the card carries 116.
So the card width is measured on brand-starters, where all six agree, and
the three left-column frames here are skipped. Their right-column twins
(306:2197 / 2204 / 2211) carry no width and ARE joined, so the gap, height
and radius are still checked on this board.
